commits.message: TASK-0056: drop nativeVirtualKeyCode from e2e pressKey
TASK-0056: collapsible, resizable sidebar and chat panel

events.text: The next action asks for a clean main checkout, and I can't switch branches or create a worktree from here. I'll look at the branch state first, then run what I can.
Implementation is already committed. Next I'll run both evals plus the help-a11y suite on this branch.
On this branch help-a11y fails one check, `#chat-help`, and the run takes 50 s, which fits a stall. I'll check whether the panel changes can explain it.
All three pass now. I'll run the full e2e set as a regression check, then commit.

TASK-0056's own panels commit caused the help-a11y stall after Esc closes the record drawer. I fixed it on this branch, and all e2e suites now pass, including both required evals.

**About the next action.** It asked me to run help-a11y on a clean main checkout. I couldn't, because I'm not allowed to switch branches or create worktrees. I compared the code with git instead:
- Main fixed this exact stall in `da05f0f` ("help-a11y e2e: drop the bogus nativeVirtualKeyCode from pressKey"). That commit landed after this branch split off from main.
- This branch's commit `71867d9` set that same field again in the shared test helper `web/e2e/lib/prelude.js`. On macOS that field maps to the wrong keys, so one unhandled Esc turns into an endless stream of key presses that starves later ones.
- On this branch before the fix, help-a11y failed 19/20 ("chat help opens the panel with focus inside") and took 50 s.

So the bug predates TASK-0056, and main had already fixed it, but this branch brought it back.

**What changed.** Commit `2a2577e` removes `nativeVirtualKeyCode` from `pressKey` and restores main's explanatory comment. It keeps the arrow, Home and End keys the panels suites need. Nothing else changed. The panels code itself, including the help-guide note, was already in `71867d9` and `caf3f05`.

**Tests and evals, after the fix:**
- E1: `node web/e2e/run.mjs --junit web/e2e/results/junit-panels.xml --suite panels` passed 48/48.
- E2: `node web/e2e/run.mjs --junit web/e2e/results/junit-panels-a11y.xml --suite panels-a11y` passed 29/29.
- `--suite help-a11y` passed 20/20 in 8.4 s (it failed 19/20 in 50.5 s before the fix).
- The full `node web/e2e/run.mjs` run passed 596/596 across all 17 suites.

**Left open**
- I didn't run anything on main. If you want direct proof rather than the git comparison, run help-a11y on a main checkout.
- The branch is behind main, so main's `prelude.js` change will meet this branch's when they're combined. The two versions now differ only in the extra key codes, so that should be easy.
- The reqforge MCP server failed to connect (its `bin/reqforge` path wasn't found), so I didn't run the trace or verify tools.
- The claude.ai Google Calendar connector needs authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before it can be used. This task didn't need it.

NEXT: Review branch reqforge/TASK-0056 (commits 71867d9, caf3f05, 2a2577e) and merge main into it, resolving web/e2e/lib/prelude.js in favour of the branch version.
